item.title: 🟠 New "Bad Epoll" Linux Kernel Flaw Lets Unprivileged Users Gain Root, Hits Android
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
A newly disclosed Linux kernel flaw called Bad Epoll (CVE-2026-46242) lets an ordinary user with no special access take full control of a machine as root. It affects Linux desktops, servers, and Android, and a fix is out. item.title: 🔵 ARToken PhaaS exposes EvilTokens' Microsoft 365 phishing toolkit
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.
A new phishing-as-a-service (PhaaS) platform dubbed "ARToken" appears to operate as an affiliate of the EvilTokens phishing platform, giving researchers a glimpse into an extensive toolkit designed to compromise Microsoft 365. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 2d ago

item.title: 🟠 Chromium: CVE-2026-13801 Integer overflow in Chromecast
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
This CVE was assigned by Chrome. Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) ingests Chromium, which addresses this vulnerability. Please see [Google Chrome Releases](https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026) for more information.

Source: Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC)  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 2d ago
